messages:
tess: Hey all, tess here. First rotation is Sunday night. Few blockers: PD says my account is pending, runbook 'serve-timeout' has a 404, and I don’t know who to escalate to for billing-impact incidents. Anyone able to help before Sunday?
oncall-bot: New rotation assignment: tess 2027-03-14 22:00-06:00 UTC. Confirm PD and Okta membership.

omar: Welcome! For PagerDuty open an infra ticket with team=eng-oncall and include your Okta username. I can fast-track once Okta group is confirmed. Billing-impact -> page @support-ops + cc the account's CSM.

jess: I fixed the runbook link; it was a bad redirect after the docs migration. infra-bot deployed a redirect, but some internal links still point to the old slug. I added a footer note with the temporary CLI fallback.

infra-bot: Redirect created: docs/runbooks/serve-timeout -> docs.redwood.internal/runbooks/serve-timeout. ACL unchanged.

tess: Thanks Omar/Jess. Omar, Okta username tess.h. Can you confirm the PD invite goes out as SMS too? I prefer texts for night pages.

omar: Yep, SMS enabled by default but sometimes needs the sms flag. I’ll add sms=optin on the ticket. Also added you to Okta `oncall-rotation`. Should sync in ~5m.

jess: Also FYI the fallback to the smaller model is a manual console switch + rolling restart. We have a scripted CLI option but it requires a service token. We normally demo both during the onboarding sim.

tess: Good to know. Any chance someone can do a quick run-through Wed evening? 30m would be great.

omar: I can do Wed 19:30 UTC. Zoom link: https://zoom.redwood/meet/omar.

tess: Confirmed. Thanks everyone!
